messages:
Carla (eng-platform): quick idea — can we add a compact permission summary card on tenant pages? shows effective roles + per-route quota preview + a single-line action (revoke/impersonate).
Ben (product): love it. main ask from enterprise sales: one glance to verify least-privilege and quota exposure.
Dan (frontend): UI Qs: where does this live? top of tenant overview, or inside 'Access' tab? top would help support calls.
Carla (eng-platform): top of overview but collapsible. default collapsed for non-admins. card should show conflicts (e.g., role allowed but route denied).
Maya (backend): API needs: an aggregated endpoint that computes effective perms + routing hints. currently we compute effective roles in query time but not per-route/quotas.
Dan (frontend): can the backend return a small digest for the card (<=2KB)? we need to avoid fetching full graph on page load.
Maya (backend): yes, we can add /v1/tenants/:id/permission_card which returns: roles[], route_summaries[], quota_flags, stale:boolean. sample: ```json
{
  "roles": ["tenant_admin","read_only"],
  "route_summaries": [{"route": "/v1/generate","allowed": true,"quota_effect": "100req/min"}],
  "quota_flags": ["near_limit"],
  "stale": false
}
```
Carla (eng-platform): nice. we should include recommended actions from product side: e.g., 'role suggests: drop read_only on route X' as a short hint.
Ben (product): +1 on recommendations but keep it advisory (not auto-change). also expose why (e.g., inherited from service account).
Liam (sre): telemetry: we want an event when card expands and when admin clicks revoke/impersonate. tag with tenant_id, actor_id, current_effective_roles. helps audits.
Maya (backend): will add telemetry hooks; suggest event names: permission_card.view and permission_card.action. payload size small.
Dan (frontend): UX question — when we show 'conflict' state, do we surface both allow and deny sources? could be noisy.
Carla (eng-platform): surface top 2 sources and a link 'view full matrix' to the access UI. keep compact.
Ben (product): for enterprise customers add a toggle to always-show card for org-admins. asked frequently.
Liam (sre): security: ensure the card respects scoping and does not leak service account tokens or sensitive principal ids. show obfuscated ids or names only.
Maya (backend): agree. return only display names + obfuscated ids. plus a boolean 'sensitive_info_available' for the full access page.
Dan (frontend): performance: lazy-load card after main content paint. fallback: skeleton with 'loading perms...'.
Carla (eng-platform): rollout plan: canary to 10% of tenants, enable via feature-flag per-tenant. collect metrics: expansion rate, action clicks, errors, card latency.
Maya (backend): feature flag in control-plane already exists; will add a gating param to API. code snippet for flag check: ```python
if feature_flags.is_enabled(tenant, 'perm_card_v1'):
    return permission_card_for(tenant)
else:
    return 404
```
Ben (product): also create a quick telemetry dashboard: card_impressions, card_latency_p50/p95, revoke_success_rate, expand_to_full_matrix %.
Liam (sre): add an alert if latency > 1s p95 for card endpoint since it's on overview load.
Dan (frontend): small accessibility note — when we show 'revoke' action, ensure keyboard focus and confirmation modal uses clear language.
Carla (eng-platform): staging checklist: API contract PR, frontend draft, telemetry queries, feature-flag toggle, docs blurb for support.
Maya (backend): i'll draft API PR by EOD. will include schema and mock payloads.
Ben (product): i can draft support docs + recommended copy.
Dan (frontend): i'll prototype card this week, put screenshot in #design when ready.
Liam (sre): i'll add SLO for endpoint and dashboard. also want sampling of full-matrix views for privacy review.
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-04T15:12:03Z completed to staging (perm-card branch).
Carla (eng-platform): awesome — next sync Thu. if anyone sees friction with backend payload size call out here.
Maya (backend): noted — will keep payload < 2KB and add pagination for route_summaries if tenant has many routes.
Ben (product): small follow-up: include a 'why' tooltip for each recommended action. helps customer trust.
Dan (frontend): ack. will wire tooltips to tooltip component.
Carla (eng-platform): thanks all. filing a mini RFC (perm-card-proposal) and linking PRs. :thumbsup:
